page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores using the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its substantial local storage capacity, consisting of 70,866 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) storage. This massive storage volume is bundled directly with the instance. For external connectivity, the server provides a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps. It does not include any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d1.6xlarge offers a high density of local HDD storage relative to its compute and memory resources, making it a specialized option for workloads requiring large-scale data retention without the premium cost of solid-state drives. Given its hardware profile, this instance is suited for storage-intensive applications, large-scale data warehousing, log processing, and distributed file systems where sequential read and write operations on high-capacity mechanical storage are acceptable.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is an x86_64 server instance designed for storage-intensive workloads. Powered by the KVM hypervisor, it features 24 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 96.0 GB of system memory. The most prominent feature of this instance is its massive bundled local storage, offering 70,866 GB of HDD capacity. It also provides a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps, with no integrated GPU resources. This hardware configuration delivers a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio alongside exceptionally high storage density. Qualitatively, it represents a cost-effective solution for massive data retention and sequential processing tasks. The ecs.d1.6xlarge is best suited for distributed file systems, large-scale data warehousing, log analysis, and cold storage applications.
